description:
## 1.77.0 (2026-11-12)

### Bug Fixes

* **Clip Studio Paint:** explain patch failure on APKs without libraries
* **DepthPix:** load wallpapers and collections again, closes #729
* **MovieBox - All-In-One:** stop downloads saving upgrade notice clip, closes #728
* **Realme Link - AMOLED dark theme:** stop APKMirror patch error, closes #739
* restore v1.77.0-dev.1 changes except Proton VPN Frosted glass
* undo v1.77.0-dev.1 changes
* **Viber - Hide Viber Out and channel promotions:** remove Contacts card, closes #704

### New Features

* **Clip Studio Paint - Open drawing on launch:** skip home screen
* **LaunchBox - Unlock premium:** remove 100-game limit
* **OK - Remove ads:** cover feed, groups, videos and clips
* **Proton VPN - Frosted glass:** blur map behind home panels and sheets, closes #713
* **ReadEra - Accent color:** replace yellow with wallpaper color
* **ReadEra - App theme:** add AMOLED option for library and menus
* **ReadEra - Copy with source:** add title and author to copied text
* **ReadEra - Full book descriptions:** show short and long text in full
* **ReadEra - Lock screen on Read chapter aloud:** keep chapter playing
* **ReadEra - Material 3 controls:** restyle switches and checkboxes
* **ReadEra - More sleep timer choices:** add 5 and 10 minutes
* **ReadEra - Page counter in long chapters:** show past 999 pages
* **ReadEra - Quotes and notes section:** share quotes and reviews
* **ReadEra - Read aloud from selection:** start at selected sentence
* **ReadEra - Read aloud notification controls:** add Stop and countdown
* **ReadEra - Read chapter aloud:** stop speech at end of chosen chapter
* **ReadEra - Search selection in book:** list matches for selected text
* **ReadEra - Speech pitch slider:** set 0.5x to 2x for each voice
* **ReadEra - Text-to-speech filter:** edit word list in patches menu
* **Xianyu - Allow sharing without login:** send public listing links
* **Xianyu - Skip login prompts:** stop unprompted login screens

### Updated App Support

* **DepthPix:** add support for `1.0.35`
* **MyScript Notes:** add support for `7.4.8`, closes #703
* **Public:** add support for `3.4.0`, closes #707
